Our FinRecon pipeline keeps producing incorrect balance totals on accounts with many small fractional transactions. QA has flagged this twice and two teammates already took a shot at fixing it — you can see their attempts in the git log and in the comments inside the reporter code — but the problem is still there and the integration tests in `tests/integration/test_reconciliation.py` are still failing.

Please investigate, find out what is actually causing this, and fix it properly. Before you apply any fix, make sure you have a test that demonstrates the problem. The fix should go in a new file called something meaningful under `tests/` to capture the root cause, and the final state should have all tests passing with no regressions.
